text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today marks El Condor Pasa's debut. Her motivated spirit burns bright as she prepares to take flight. However…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's disappointed with the lack of international media attention her debut has garnered. In the end, this only drives her desire to make her presence known.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the cheers of her friends propelling her forward, El Condor Pasa sets off for her debut race, ready to take the world by storm.
